The 73 cases after passed-through-event-without-data were written from the TypeScript sources before either harness ran.

Version 3: 182 cases. Refused values print as JSON.stringify prints them, so does-not-close-float-turn loses its rust marker, and compaction-seqs-fraction-refused and title-exponent-refused, written from the TypeScript sources before either harness ran, witness a writer-spelled number in a targets-consumed refusal.
